overview: A reporting of gross sales clause in commercial leases requires tenants (usually retailers) to provide periodic, certified statements of total revenue generated from the premises, typically monthly or annually. This clause ensures accurate calculation of percentage rent (if applicable), helps landlords gauge, and allows for audits to verify that sales are not understated.
